query: SELECT (SELECT state FROM central.step_attempts WHERE id = $1) AS "attempt!", (SELECT state FROM central.steps WHERE id = $2) AS "step!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.events WHERE workspace_id = $3 AND kind = 'execution.recovery.reconciliation_required') AS "evidence!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.outbox WHERE workspace_id = $3 AND catalog_type = 'execution.reconciliation.required') AS "outbox!"
